summary: A high-performance vector indexing library in Rust with Python bindings, designed for approximate nearest neighbor search, embeddings, and RAG workflows.
usecases: Accelerating similarity search in large-scale embedding datasets for semantic search engines
Powering RAG systems with low-latency vector retrieval
Enabling real-time nearest-neighbor queries in resource-constrained environments via Rust optimization
ideas: Combine with LangChain to build a fully local, privacy-first LLM assistant
Deploy as a WebAssembly module for browser-based vector search without a backend
Optimize for specific hardware (AVX-512) to accelerate embedding comparison in scientific computing
